style.styleTitle: Personalised Photo Upload Wooden Christmas Bauble by PMC
style.toneOfVoice: This personalised photo upload round wooden decoration, would make the perfect addition to your Christmas tree! You can personalise with a photo and 3 lines of personalisation. The first line will appear as entered and lines 2 & 3 will appear in fixed upper case. Photo dimensions are: 88mm x 63mm. Please ensure the image is of the highest quality as possible. This round decoration is made from wood with ribbon included. Dimensions Height 10.7 cm Width 10 cm Depth 0.6 cm.
